question: How can I track my order?
answer: Once your order ships, we email you a tracking link. You can also open Order History in your account and select the order to see its latest status and carrier updates.

question: Where is my package and how do I find its tracking number?
answer: Once your order ships, we email you a tracking link. You can also open Order History in your account and select the order to see its latest status and carrier updates.

question: My order tracking has not updated. What should I do?
answer: Carrier scans can take up to 24 hours to appear after dispatch. If tracking has not changed after two business days, contact support with your order number and we will investigate.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: You can request cancellation from Order History while an order is still being prepared. Once it has shipped, it cannot be cancelled, but you can start a return after delivery.

question: I want to cancel an order I just placed.
answer: You can request cancellation from Order History while an order is still being prepared. Once it has shipped, it cannot be cancelled, but you can start a return after delivery.

question: How do I stop or cancel an order before it ships?
answer: Open Order History, select the order, and choose Cancel order if the option is available. If it is no longer available, contact support as soon as possible.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: Go to Order History, select the item, and choose Start a return. Most unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery in their original packaging. The return page will provide your next steps.

question: Can I send something back if I changed my mind?
answer: Most unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery in their original packaging. Start the request from Order History. Some final-sale and personalized items are not eligible.

question: What is your return window and how do I start a return?
answer: You have 30 days from delivery to return most unused items. Open Order History, select the item, and choose Start a return to get instructions.

question: When will I receive my refund?
answer: After we receive and inspect your return, refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days. Your bank may need additional time to post the credit.

question: Can I get my money back for a returned item?
answer: Eligible returned items are refunded to the original payment method after they arrive and pass inspection. Processing usually takes 5 to 10 business days.

question: I have not received the refund for my order yet.
answer: Refunds usually take 5 to 10 business days after a return is received and inspected. If that time has passed, contact support with your order number so we can check its status.

question: How long does standard delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery typically takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Delivery estimates for your address are shown at checkout and in your shipping confirmation.

question: Where is my package?
answer: Check the tracking link in your shipping confirmation or open Order History for the latest carrier update. If tracking has not updated for two business days, contact support.

question: Do you offer express or next-day shipping?
answer: Available delivery options depend on the items and destination. Enter your address at checkout to see whether express or next-day shipping is available and what it costs.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover credit or debit cards, along with PayPal and Shop Pay where available. Available methods appear at checkout.

question: What cards can I use to pay?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover credit or debit cards. You can also use PayPal or Shop Pay where available.

question: Why was my card payment declined?
answer: Check that your billing address and card details are correct and that your bank has not blocked the transaction. Your bank can explain a decline; you can also try another payment method at checkout.

question: Can I pay with PayPal or a debit card?
answer: Yes. We accept PayPal and major debit cards, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover. The checkout page shows which options are available for your order.

question: How do I apply a discount code or coupon?
answer: Enter your promo code in the Discount code field at checkout and select Apply before placing the order. Only one code can be used per order unless the offer says otherwise.

question: My coupon code is not working. What can I do?
answer: Check the code's spelling, expiration date, minimum spend, and eligible products. Codes usually cannot be combined. If it still fails, contact support with the code and a screenshot of your cart.

question: Can I use more than one promo code on an order?
answer: Usually only one discount code can be applied per order. The terms of a specific promotion will say if it can be combined with another offer.

question: How do I create a ShopAssist account?
answer: Select Account, then choose Create account. Enter your email address and follow the verification link we send you to finish setting up your account.

question: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
answer: On the sign-in page, select Forgot password and enter your account email. We will send you a password reset link. Check your spam folder if the email does not arrive within a few minutes.

question: Can I check out without creating an account?
answer: Yes. Choose guest checkout and provide an email address for your order confirmation and tracking updates. You can create an account later using that email.

question: My product arrived broken. What should I do?
answer: We are sorry your item arrived damaged. Contact support within 7 days of delivery with your order number and clear photos of the item and packaging. We will arrange a replacement or refund.

question: I received the wrong item in my order.
answer: Please contact support within 7 days of delivery with your order number and a photo of the item and its packaging. We will help arrange the correct item or a refund.

question: An item is missing from my package. How do I report it?
answer: Check your order confirmation first, since items may ship separately. If an item is missing, contact support with your order number and a photo of the package and packing slip.

question: Can I change the shipping address after placing an order?
answer: Contact support as soon as possible with your order number and corrected address. We can update it only before the order is packed or handed to the carrier.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: Contact support as soon as possible with your order number and corrected address. We can update it only before the order is packed or handed to the carrier.

question: I entered the wrong address at checkout. What should I do?
answer: Contact support immediately with your order number and the correct address. Address changes are possible only before your order has been packed or shipped.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: Use the Contact Support form on our website or email support@shopassist.example. Include your order number and a brief description so our team can help faster. We reply within one business day.

question: What are your customer service hours?
answer: Our support team is available Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern Time. You can email us any time and we will reply within one business day.

question: I need help with an order. How do I reach a person?
answer: Contact our support team using the website Contact Support form or email support@shopassist.example. Include your order number and we will reply within one business day.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: We currently ship to select countries. Enter your delivery address at checkout to confirm availability, shipping fees, and any estimated customs charges for your destination.

question: Will I have to pay sales tax or import duties?
answer: Applicable sales tax is calculated at checkout. International orders may be subject to import duties or local taxes charged by your country's customs authority upon delivery.
